dedupe_keys.name: china 1 km land use and land cover under 24 ssp rcp scenarios 2020 to 2100 gcam and flus luo and co authors 2022

description: This dataset projects land use and land cover for China at 1 km under 24 SSP-RCP scenarios from 2020 to 2100 in 10-year steps, with careful treatment of urban land change. Meng Luo and co-authors at East China Normal University and partner institutions published it with a data descriptor in Scientific Data in March 2022. It couples the Global Change Analysis Model, which sets land demand by scenario, with the Future Land Use Simulation model, which allocates it on the grid; results agree well with ESA CCI land cover and are broadly consistent with the Land Use Harmonization v2 dataset. Coverage is mainland China. Format and access: GeoTIFF files in Albers equal-area projection grouped by scenario, on figshare and the geosimulation site. Licence: not stated on the pages read; the article is open access; free. Caveats: decade steps miss short-term change, and 1 km cells blur urban green space. It supports scenario studies of ecosystem services, green infrastructure and hazard exposure in China. Related catalogue records are the global 1 km PLUS projections and the Chen, Li and Liu global projections.
